author: reek
body: The transport offers a work under the digest the quotation asked for, and the content it hands over is not that work. Here it adds one to what the real sort-ascending returns.

author: reek
body: Nothing about the signature is wrong: the signer is known and the signature verifies against the bytes that were signed. The lie is between the digest and the content, and only hashing the content ourselves can find it. That is the second guard, and this is what it is for.
